entries.title: Isaiah 27:1
segments: ¶In that day the LORD with His severe sword, great and strong, Will punish Leviathan the fleeing serpent, Leviathan that twisted serpent; And He will slay the reptile that [is] in the sea.

entries.title: Isaiah 27:2
segments: In that day sing to her, "A vineyard of red wine!

entries.title: Isaiah 27:3
segments: I, the LORD, keep it, I water it every moment; Lest any hurt it, I keep it night and day.

entries.title: Isaiah 27:4
segments: Fury [is] not in Me. Who would set briers [and] thorns Against Me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.

entries.title: Isaiah 27:5
segments: Or let him take hold of My strength, [That] he may make peace with Me; [And] he shall make peace with Me."

entries.title: Isaiah 27:6
segments: Those who come He shall cause to take root in Jacob; Israel shall blossom and bud, And fill the face of the world with fruit.

entries.title: Isaiah 27:7
segments: ¶Has He struck Israel as He struck those who struck him? Or has He been slain according to the slaughter of those who were slain by Him?

entries.title: Isaiah 27:8
segments: In measure, by sending it away, You contended with it. He removes [it] by His rough wind In the day of the east wind.

entries.title: Isaiah 27:9
segments: Therefore by this the iniquity of Jacob will be covered; And this [is] all the fruit of taking away his sin: When he makes all the stones of the altar Like chalkstones that are beaten to dust, Wooden images and incense altars shall not stand.

entries.title: Isaiah 27:10
segments: Yet the fortified city [will be] desolate, The habitation forsaken and left like a wilderness; There the calf will feed, and there it will lie down And consume its branches.

entries.title: Isaiah 27:11
segments: When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off; The women come [and] set them on fire. For it [is] a people of no understanding; Therefore He who made them will not have mercy on them, And He who formed them will show them no favor.

entries.title: Isaiah 27:12
segments: And it shall come to pass in that day [That] the LORD will thresh, From the channel of the River to the Brook of Egypt; And you will be gathered one by one, O you children of Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 27:13
segments: So it shall be in that day: The great trumpet will be blown; They will come, who are about to perish in the land of Assyria, And they who are outcasts in the land of Egypt, And shall worship the LORD in the holy mount at Jerusalem.
